contacts.introTitle: I'm a graphic designer specializing in branding, logos, and web and promotional visuals.
contacts.introDescription: My focus is on creating clear, memorable and purpose-driven design solutions that help brands grow and communicate effectively. I work efficiently, responsibly, and with a strong commitment to understanding each client's goals - turning ideas into visuals that make an impact.
contacts.experienceDescription: I have around 3 years of experience in graphic design, working on logo creation, brand identity, promotional graphics, posters, 3D modeling, animation, and web design layouts. Since 2023, I've been actively developing and showcasing my design work on my account @kipras_design, constantly improving my style and technical skills.
contacts.studioNameDescription: CU/ONE brings together two symbolic origins: CU stands for copper - the first metal shaped by human hands, symbolizing craftsmanship, creative foundations, and reflecting the Latin origin of the name Kipras. This also inspired the copper-toned orange used in the identity. ONE represents the first spark of creation. Together, they express the studio's link to ancient craft, personal roots, and new creative beginnings.
